spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). A bright, minimal Japanese-style cake shop by a big window. The woman and the man sit across from each other at a small wooden table, a slice of Japanese strawberry shortcake on a plate between them; she holds a fork, both smiling shyly. A glass display case of fruit cakes in the background with blank labels. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
